payload.directive: Individual Frank workers must intelligently self-network inside the repo-native Research Center instead of operating as isolated spokes whose every research message is relayed through ChatGPT.
mandatory_behaviors: discover active Frank peers at JOIN/pulse
detect duplicate lanes and convert them to complementary/adversarial/replication work
form temporary specialist subteams around material blockers
route cross-branch deltas only to dependent Frank workers when possible
cross-read sibling evidence before strong architecture claims
record explicit disposition of material peer feedback
prefer executable discriminators over repeated prose disagreement
payload.supersession_note: Any older wording in the Frank cascade that could be read as forbidding direct worker-to-worker research coordination is narrowed: ChatGPT is the sole GLOBAL scheduler/adjudicator, but is not a mandatory relay for every peer interaction. The new FRANK_WORKER_RESEARCH_CENTER_MESH_PROTOCOL.md is the active interpretation.
payload.epistemic_guard: peer agreement never increases evidence strength by itself; shared ancestry remains correlated evidence; final promotion remains evidence-gated
